class.name: WorldStreamer
class.brief_description: Loads a large world's cells round the player and drops them behind.

method.name: add_cell
method.description: Adds a cell: its [param area] on the map (x and z, in metres), the [param scene] that loads near it, and optionally a lighter [param far_scene] shown further out.

method.name: clear_cells
method.description: Removes every cell, and frees whatever of them was loaded.

method.name: get_cell_node
method.description: The root of a cell's scene while its detail is in the world, or [code]null[/code].

method.name: get_cells
method.description: The names of every cell added.

method.name: is_busy
method.description: Whether cells are still wanted, loading or joining the world: while it's [code]true[/code], keep a loading screen or fade up.

method.name: is_cell_loaded
method.description: Whether a cell's detail is in the world, all of it.

method.name: load_around
method.description: Loads every cell within [param radius] metres of [param position] (on the map) before returning: for putting the player somewhere new, behind a loading screen or a fade.

method.name: remove_cell
method.description: Removes a cell, and frees it if it was loaded.

members.member: Milliseconds a frame for cells joining the world, and half that for those leaving it. Six times as much while [member FrameBudget.screen_hidden] is set.
Metres out to which cells show their far scene where their detail isn't loaded. 0 shows no far scenes.
Metres beyond which far scenes are dropped. Set it above [member far_radius], so a far scene isn't loaded and dropped again as the observer moves back and forth at its edge.
Metres from the observer, on the ground, within which cells load.
How many cells load at the same time.
What cells load round: the player, or what the camera follows. Unless set, the viewport's camera.

Called on a worker thread with each cell's name, its scene's root and whether it's the far scene ([code]func(name: String, node: Node, far: bool)[/code]), before it joins the world: for heavy work of your own on a cell, such as building collision from its meshes. The root isn't in the tree yet, so keep to the cell itself.
Metres from the observer beyond which cells are dropped. Set it above [member load_radius], so a cell isn't loaded and dropped again as the observer moves back and forth at its edge.

signal.name: cell_loaded
signal.description: A cell's scene ([param far] for its far scene) has joined the world, all of it.

signal.name: cell_unloading
signal.description: A cell's scene ([param far] for its far scene) is leaving the world: it's hidden now, and freed over the next frames.
